start.title: [TODO:de] A Question Burns
start.text:
[TODO:de] You see Jesus on the road.
A question burns inside you.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Run past, too proud to ask

pride_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Do Not Walk On
pride_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] The question will not leave you.
Go and ask him.

eternal_life.title: [TODO:de] Good Teacher
eternal_life.text:
[TODO:de] You kneel. "What must I do
to inherit eternal life?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Truth is not bought with haste.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Boast of your good deeds first

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Be Still
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Eternal things ask quiet hearts.
Wait and listen.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Listen First
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Boasting closes the ear.
Let him speak.

commandments.title: [TODO:de] You Know Them
commandments.text:
[TODO:de] "Do not kill, steal, or lie.
Honor your father and mother."

choices.text: [TODO:de] Brush them off as too easy

easy_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Weigh Them
easy_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] The commandments are not small.
Receive them again.

claim.title: [TODO:de] All My Life
claim.text:
[TODO:de] "All these I have kept
since I was a boy."

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] He looks at you and loves you.

lie_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Be Honest
lie_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] He sees the corners of your soul.
Speak the truth.

the poor, and follow me."

choices.text: [TODO:de] Argue that wealth is a gift

conflict.text:
[TODO:de] Your gold feels heavy in your hand.
Your soul feels heavier.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Open your hands to let go

surrender_path.text:
[TODO:de] You almost let go.
But the weight is too great.

walk_away.text:
[TODO:de] You turn away, deeply sad.
Your wealth holds you back.

forget_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] His eyes still find you.
Remember what you felt.
